loop_geometry: Q question calls; inside each call one groupby over observed response_value_normalized groups
scan_count_formula: Q calls; per q one answer-response grouping over R_q rows (plus semantics dictionary probes per observed response group)
join_formula: none; response semantics are resolved by dictionary lookup
checkpoint_behavior: one per-question checkpoint write for answer_distribution; final shard table written once
primary_cost_driver: question-row scan/grouping and per-category semantic resolution

invocation_scope: once per executed V550 question within build_distribution_tables
loop_geometry: Q question calls; per q outer country grouping then response grouping within each country
scan_count_formula: Q calls; per q one country partition plus sum_c one response grouping over country_frame
join_formula: none; response semantics are resolved by dictionary lookup
checkpoint_behavior: one per-question checkpoint write for country_answer_distribution; final shard table written once
primary_cost_driver: country partitioning plus response grouping inside each country

invocation_scope: once per V550 shard after the question loop, over country frames in question_row_cache
loop_geometry: for each country c: respondent-slice copy/sort/dedupe, then loop I_c present position fields and group by position value
input_grain: cached response-long country frame collapsed to one row per respondent-country before position grouping
scan_count_formula: sum_c [one sort/dedupe pass over N_c cache rows + I_c field mask/subset/grouping passes over R_c respondent rows]
checkpoint_behavior: no per-question checkpoint; computed post-loop and written once in final shard outputs
primary_cost_driver: country-frame sort/dedupe plus repeated position-field grouping

loop_geometry: per q loop I_q present indicators; compute entropy/MI/NMI/Cramer's V; weighted path additionally groups by indicator value
scan_count_formula: sum_q I_q indicator vector/mask/stat passes; weighted path adds up to sum_q I_q groupby('x') operations
output_cardinality_formula: sum_q I_q (at most one row per usable indicator)
checkpoint_behavior: one per-question checkpoint write; final shard table written once

loop_geometry: per q loop I_q; unweighted crosstab indicator×answer; weighted path also pivot_table; emit rectangular cells
scan_count_formula: sum_q I_q crosstab passes; weighted runs add sum_q I_q weighted pivot passes
output_cardinality_formula: sum_q sum_i (V_{q,i} * C_{q,i}) where C_{q,i} is response-column count in the indicator-masked crosstab
checkpoint_behavior: one per-question checkpoint write; final shard table written once

loop_geometry: per q loop I_q; group question frame by each indicator; scan every nonblank support-eligible indicator-value subgroup and classify its dominant response
scan_count_formula: sum_q I_q indicator groupby operations plus subgroup response scans over each observed indicator value
output_cardinality_formula: sum_q sum_i F_{q,i}, F_{q,i}=nonblank indicator-value groups meeting support threshold
checkpoint_behavior: one per-question checkpoint write; final shard table written once

loop_geometry: first pass scores I_q indicators; selects one primary; second pass tests each other candidate against primary, at most I_q-1 joint conditional-entropy calls
scan_count_formula: sum_q [I_q first-pass indicator scans + at most (I_q-1) joint-mask/joint-key scans]; weighted paths add subgroup groupbys
join_formula: none; joint key is string concatenation primary||secondary
output_cardinality_formula: sum_q S_q with 0 <= S_q <= max(I_q-1,0); rows emit only for joint support >=50 and secondary_gain>0
checkpoint_behavior: one per-question checkpoint write; final shard table written once
primary_cost_driver: duplicated first-pass indicator scoring plus primary×secondary joint entropy checks

loop_geometry: binary recursive tree; at each visited nonterminal node evaluate every remaining indicator, choose best gain, recurse into at most top 2 values
scan_count_formula: B node response scans; candidate split evaluations <= sum_q sum_{d=0}^{d*_q-1} 2^d*(I_q-d), d*_q=min(D,I_q)
output_cardinality_formula: B=sum_q B_q; B_q <= 2^(d*_q+1)-1, d*_q=min(D,I_q), before support/no-gain pruning
checkpoint_behavior: one per-question checkpoint write; final shard table written once
primary_cost_driver: repeated conditional-entropy evaluation across remaining indicators at every recursive node

invocation_scope: per question only when should_emit_cloud_tables permits current cloud family work
loop_geometry: scan E_q candidate position-coordinate columns; compute association stats against response; sort all candidates; emit top max_features=5
scan_count_formula: sum_{q in Q_cloud} E_q candidate feature association-stat passes
output_cardinality_formula: sum_{q in Q_cloud} min(5, E'_q) where E'_q are valid scored position candidates
checkpoint_behavior: one per cloud-enabled question checkpoint write; final shard table written once
primary_cost_driver: candidate feature association statistics followed by full candidate sort

invocation_scope: per question only when cloud gate permits; publication additionally contract-gated
loop_geometry: scan L_q relation-evidence candidate columns; compute association stats; sort candidates; emit top max_features=5
scan_count_formula: sum_{q in Q_cloud} L_q candidate relation-feature association-stat passes
output_cardinality_formula: sum_{q in Q_cloud} min(5, L'_q) subject to relation-role validity and allowed_as_branch_relation_cosignature contract
checkpoint_behavior: one per cloud-enabled question checkpoint write; final shard table written once; branch_co_signature is later copied as compatibility alias

invocation_scope: per cloud-enabled question with state keyed by run/source/wave/country
loop_geometry: current anchor-enabled q iterates every previously registered question frame; each attempted pair does respondent_id inner merge, crosstab, NMI and Cramer's V
scan_count_formula: P_state=sum_{anchor q} N_prev_registered(q) pair calls; P_state <= Q_cloud*(Q_cloud-1)/2 when every cloud question is registered and anchor-enabled
join_formula: P_state inner joins on respondent_id; each surviving join followed by one response×response crosstab
output_cardinality_formula: <= P_state (at most one highest-overlap-cell row per attempted eligible pair)
checkpoint_behavior: one per cloud-enabled question checkpoint write; in-memory pair state is reset before loop and is not reconstructed merely by skipping resumed questions
primary_cost_driver: stateful pairwise respondent joins and crosstabs

invocation_scope: once per V550 shard requirement resolution; shared substrate optionally materialized once per country; V550J prepared country state cached across applicable families
loop_geometry: resolve base Q question rows plus sum_j K_j governed registry items; canonicalize N_c long rows; write path serializes/revalidates each country substrate
input_grain: shared respondent-response long rows selected by union(base V550 vars, governed V550J-required vars)
scan_count_formula: requirement selection O(Q + sum_j K_j); per materialized country: canonicalization over N_c + at least 3 full logical-content hash passes + 2 duplicate-key validation passes + one parquet reload
join_formula: V550 extraction none; V550J prepared path later inner-merges prepared_country_frame to active_family_lookup_df on var_code_norm once per cached country state
output_cardinality_formula: sum_c N_c shared long rows; N_c is response-long and cannot be inferred from respondent count R_c alone
checkpoint_behavior: atomic parquet+schema+manifest+validation+COMPLETE per country; cache validity/hash checked before reuse
primary_cost_driver: long-row normalization/serialization plus repeated logical hashing and cache validation

invocation_scope: once per governed V550J family/configuration j per country
loop_geometry: group family rows by respondent; for each respondent loop K_j ordered items and filter respondent rows by var_code; then group eligible respondent summaries by raw+semantic signature
scan_count_formula: per j,c: one respondent groupby + sum over eligible respondents of K_j item filters over that respondent's family rows + one signature groupby over R_{j,c} summarized respondents
join_formula: no dataframe join inside _summarize_respondents; family rows were selected upstream via prepared frame/family lookup
output_cardinality_formula: M_{j,c} <= R_{j,c}; with complete K_j items, M_{j,c} <= min(R_{j,c}, product_k C_{j,k}); with minimum m_j<K_j, loose signature bound min(R_{j,c}, sum_{S subset K_j, |S|>=m_j} product_{k in S} C_{j,k})
checkpoint_behavior: family tables accumulate in memory and are concatenated/written as run-final V550J tables; no per-family resume checkpoint observed in compiler
primary_cost_driver: respondent grouping plus K_j repeated item filtering and signature grouping

invocation_scope: once per governed family/configuration j per country after pattern construction
loop_geometry: primary path inner-merges respondent summaries to pattern table on available pattern signature columns, then iterates merged rows; fallback builds respondent lookup then loops pattern respondent_ids
input_grain: eligible respondent summaries plus joint pattern rows
scan_count_formula: one signature merge per j,c plus one output-row iteration; fallback one respondent groupby + nested iteration over stored member ids
join_formula: one inner merge on pattern_signature_raw and/or pattern_signature_semantic per j,c in primary path
output_cardinality_formula: sum_{j,c} MSHIP_{j,c}; standard signature-merge path is one membership row per eligible summarized respondent, so MSHIP_{j,c}<=R_{j,c}
checkpoint_behavior: materialized as joint_pattern_respondent_membership in run-final V550J outputs
primary_cost_driver: signature merge and row-wise membership record construction

invocation_scope: per governed family/configuration j per country when association mode is candidate_trace or publishable and authorized outside-family context exists
loop_geometry: fast path filters eligible outside-family context, inner-merges membership rows to context on respondent_id_norm, then groups joined rows at pattern, pattern×var, pattern×var×response, baseline var×response and baseline var grains
input_grain: pattern-membership respondent rows joined to outside-family response-long context
scan_count_formula: per j,c: one eligibility scan of context + one membership-context join; aggregate passes: groupby pattern, pattern×var, pattern×var×response, baseline var×response, baseline var; row-wise candidate metric/classification passes over A_{j,c} candidate groups
join_formula: one inner merge membership×eligible_context on respondent_id_norm, then 4 left merges into candidate_counts: pattern totals; pattern×var totals; baseline var×response; baseline var totals
output_cardinality_formula: A=sum_{j,c} A_{j,c}, where A_{j,c}=observed (pattern_id,var_code,response_value) groups after respondent overlap/authority filtering; A_{j,c} <= M_{j,c} * sum_v C_v but only observed overlap groups materialize
checkpoint_behavior: candidate trace is retained only when diagnostics/mode requires it; family frames accumulate, then final table write
primary_cost_driver: membership×context join expansion plus grouped candidate aggregation

invocation_scope: per family/country after candidate generation, then governed-lane reconciliation in compiler
loop_geometry: boolean publication mask over candidate trace; compiler then iterates associated_var_code rows to classify against governed lane registry and filters non-publishable index rows
scan_count_formula: O(A) publication-mask pass + O(PUB_pre) governed registry classification/reconciliation pass
join_formula: none after candidate table is formed
output_cardinality_formula: PUB <= A; final joint_pattern_association_index may be smaller than pre-reconciliation publication mask
checkpoint_behavior: published association index accumulated by family and written once as final V550J table

invocation_scope: V550 per executed question plus finalization; shared/prepared country caches; V550J final run outputs
loop_geometry: V550 question loop writes 9 unconditional table checkpoints, +3 when cloud gate emits, +1 mapping-gap checkpoint when nonempty, then one COMPLETE marker per handled question
input_grain: per-question result tables and country shared substrate
scan_count_formula: question checkpoint writes = 9*Q_exec + 3*Q_cloud + Q_gap; completion markers=Q_handled; finalization re-reads/combines checkpoint tables when checkpoint source selected
output_cardinality_formula: serialized rows equal rows of each checkpointed family; bytes depend on live data/encoding and are BLOCKED_REAL_MEASUREMENT
checkpoint_behavior: resume skips questions whose checkpoint exists; checkpoints-only mode verifies all keys before skipping execution; shared substrate uses parquet+manifest+validation+COMPLETE; V550J compiler has run-final table materialization rather than per-family resume checkpoints
primary_cost_driver: repeated per-question serialization plus final checkpoint combination and final table serialization

computation_family: repeated scans between V550 and V550J
invocation_scope: cross-family implementation baseline across one V550 shard and its governed V550J workload
loop_geometry: same V550 question frame is independently consumed by distributions, indicator summary, secondary summary, matrix, outlier, recursion, and optional cloud families; V550J prepared/forensic modes can add harmonization and repeated per-family context filtering
input_grain: question-response frames and shared/prepared response-long country frames
scan_count_formula: at minimum per q: distribution grouping + I_q summary + I_q secondary-first-pass + <=I_q-1 secondary-joint + I_q matrix + I_q outlier + recursive node evaluations + optional E_q/L_q/cloud pair scans; shared write adds 3 logical hash passes; V550J fallback can harmonize roughly K_j question frames when prepared state unavailable
join_formula: V550 cloud adds P_state respondent joins; V550J prepared path adds one country prepared×family-lookup merge per cached country state plus per-family membership×context association join
output_cardinality_formula: no independent output table; this row accounts for repeated work already represented in families 1-17
checkpoint_behavior: V550 manifest records prepared/per-question/fallback harmonization counts; V550J performance profile records harmonization call totals and stage times, but no live profile was available to this feeder
primary_cost_driver: duplicate scans/statistics over identical frames, stateful pair joins, shared-substrate hash passes, and substrate-mode-dependent reharmonization
evidence_symbol: question loop; harmonization counters; country_prepared_state; write_shared_respondent_substrate_atomic
